reading.zh: 三种单例形态并列，按“要不要 MonoBehaviour”递增：base 供普通 C# 类（懒 new）、mono 需手动挂到场景、auto-mono 首次取值时自动建对象并跨场景保留。
reading.en: Three singleton flavours side by side, increasing in MonoBehaviour-ness: base for plain C# classes (lazy new), mono requires manual placement, auto-mono creates its own object and survives scenes.
